name: S1-Q09 - Wayfinder Connections
text:
[Slotless][Generic]

---

Effect Thanks to your connection with Venture-Captain Muesello, you have an easier time securing Wayfinders. You can purchase wayfinders of up to your character level + 2 as long as you have access to them. If you own a Standard Wayfinder, Muesello offers to upgrade it to a Wayfinder with additional features for the difference in cost between the items.
